notes: Scoring contract for tools/cann_analyze/locate.py. The loader in locate.py treats this file as the contract and ships an identical built-in fallback, so a missing or corrupt file degrades to the values below instead of raising.
weights are additive integer points. A candidate site accumulates points for every signal it shares with the log record.

fingerprint_exact is awarded when the record fingerprint equals the site fingerprint; otherwise fingerprint_overlap multiplies the multiplier by the Jaccard token overlap, but only when the overlap reaches fingerprint_overlap_floor.
basename is awarded when the site basename equals the record basename or one of its ageing/aging variants. path_suffix / path_variant are extra points when the indexed relative path also matches.
line_exact is awarded for the same line; line_near for a distance up to line_near_tolerance. line_drift is recorded as a reason only, it adds no points.

min_score is the lowest score that keeps a candidate. Candidates below it are dropped, which is what makes index_miss true. locate_record(min_score=...) can override it per call as the explicit negative-case control.
confidence maps a kept score to a band: the first band whose min_score is reached wins, else fallback. Bands are sorted by min_score descending when loaded.
line_refresh_delta is the line distance beyond which analysis_basis flags the index snapshot as stale and asks for a refresh.
limits.query_fetch_limit caps rows fetched per search_sites query. limits.default_result_limit is the number of locations returned when the caller passes no limit.
query_planner controls the token scan: tokens shorter than distinctive_min_length are ignored and at most distinctive_max_tokens are used. An empty token list skips the token queries entirely.

min_score was raised from 20 to 25 after calibration (2026-10, catalogs/eval/labeled_cases.json): at 20 the single false positive n-generic-malloc ('malloc failed, size=4096') was admitted by fingerprint_overlap alone at exactly the old floor, while every positive match scores >= 70. At 25 the labelled set measures hit@1 0.9286, hit@3 1.0000 and zero false positives. Because min_score is now 25, the weak band is unreachable for returned locations; it stays declared so that a caller overriding min_score lower still gets a stable label.
